title: NovaForge Labs lab results dataset: lot-specific certificates of analysis for research peptides
description:
Every certificate of analysis (COA) published by NovaForge Labs, in one machine-readable CSV: 26 lot-specific results from two independent US laboratories (Freedom Diagnostics: identity by LC-MS, HPLC purity, net content; ILS Laboratories: identity by HPLC retention time vs reference standard, HPLC purity). Median HPLC purity 99.78% (range 99.03–99.99%; 20 of 26 at or above 99.5%). Columns: product, lot number, lab report ID, HPLC purity, test date, link to the original PDF.

Limits: identity and purity only; no sterility, endotoxin, heavy-metal or residual-solvent testing. HPLC purity is not net peptide content. Products are sold for laboratory research use only.

Live version: https://novaforgelabs.co/lab-results-dataset
